findings.Partial_conv3: Convolves dim//n_div channels and concatenates untouched channels. SFR keeps all C channels in branch2a and uses dense cross-channel spatial factors.
findings.Faster_Block_Rep_EMA: Inherited Faster_Block_EMA executes partial RepConv mixing, MLP, DropPath and EMA attention. None are transplanted.
findings.Strip_Block: DW5x5 then sequential asymmetric DW convolutions, 1x1 projection, unbounded multiplicative attention. SFR-D uses parallel DW1x5 + DW5x1 on latent rank channels with bounded identity gain.
findings.Strip_Attention: Actual forward comments out x = self.spatial_gating_unit(x); the declared strip gating unit does not execute.
findings.CPCA: Channel pooling attention, DW5x5, multiple sequential strip scales 7/11/21 and projections. SFR-D has no pooling/channel attention/multiscale strip aggregation.
